 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in g for x in row),key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in g))
    bar=next(i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg)
    bc=g[bar][0]
    obj=next(x for row in g for x in row if x not in (bg,bc))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==obj]
    top=min(r for r,c in pts); bottom=max(r for r,c in pts)
    # Shift object vertically to touch the marker from its original side; put 8 on far side.
    if bottom < bar:
        shift=bar-1-bottom
        for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts:g[r+shift][c]=obj
        sep=bar-2
    else:
        shift=bar+1-top
        for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts:g[r+shift][c]=obj
        sep=bar+1+(bottom-top)+1
    if 0<=sep<h:g[sep]=[8]*w
    return g
",
 "path": "programs/task-7f705bce.py"
}
